1.explanation:
• ResizeBehavior.js triggers the resize operation but does not delegate a full update of connected labels/associations.
• LayoutConnectionBehavior.js listens for shape changes and re-lays out SequenceFlows, but only recomputes waypoints, not attached labels or association edges.
• ConnectionLayoutUtil.js computes new segment geometry for connections but does not reposition attachments.
• LabelLayoutUtil.js contains the algorithms for placing text labels on edges; it is never invoked after an automatic layout pass triggered by a shape resize.
• LineAttachmentUtil.js manages association arrowheads/text attachments on a connection, but is not called during the flow relayout on resize.

Together these five files cover the resize hook, the connection re-routing, and the label/association placement logic. Because the relayout step skips label/association routines, the labels and associations end up in the wrong place.
1.bug_scenario: When you resize a BPMN sub-process that has an outgoing SequenceFlow with attached labels (text annotations) or Association edges, the SequenceFlow is re-routed correctly but its labels and associations remain at their old coordinates instead of following the updated edge geometry. In other words, on container resize the connector layout is updated, but neither LabelLayoutUtil nor the line-attachment logic is re-invoked for the label/association, so those remain hanging off in the wrong place.

2.explanation:
• BpmnAutoResizeProvider.js hooks into the resize command and triggers connection re-layout on container size changes, but it only updates the edge waypoints of BPMN flows.
• LayoutConnectionBehavior.js listens for layout events and applies new waypoints, yet it does not consider repositioning of attached labels or Associations (text annotation links).
• ConnectionLayoutUtil.js computes the new path for the connection segments but only handles the core sequence flow path, not its decorative attachments (labels/annotation associations).
• LabelLayoutUtil.js is responsible for computing inline label positions along a connection but isn’t invoked on auto-resize events. As a result, neither edge labels nor Associations (for text annotations) are updated when the underlying flow moves.
2.bug_scenario: After resizing a subprocess (or any container) the attached SequenceFlow is re-laid out (its waypoints recomputed) but any labels (edge labels) and text annotation associations that were attached to that sequence flow are left at their old positions. Essentially, connection geometry updates on container resize, but neither the SequenceFlow’s label nor the Text Annotation’s dotted Association are reconnected/moved with the flow.
